g.text: Issue side panel over the board
Opens when you click a card from
Reference: briareus-windows. Other clients match this structure, differing only as noted here.

Columns are 300 to 380px with 12px gaps and share the width when they fit; otherwise the board scrolls sideways with a bar along the bottom. Each column scrolls on its own down to the window's bottom.

You can drag a card to another column (needs a Manage token and Projects: write). A card from another repository opens on GitHub; a card from this one opens its issue or PR in the side panel, which really overlays the board rather
With an assignee picked, a 'Showing 5 of 14' line with an accent 'Clear filter' link shows above the columns. A board over 2,000 items warns 'Only the board's first 2,000 items are shown.'

Errors and empty state: 'Reading a board needs Projects: read on the server's GitHub token (read:project on a classic token)…' / 'Nothing on the board — No item on this board matches its view's filter.' Loading: 'Loading the
Region names (sidebar, canvas, raise, sunken) are the theme.* roles; widths and margins are layout.* in tokens/. Greys only, on purpose.
